name: LeMoyne-Owen College
oos_note: Private HBCU (independent) - single rate = in-state, so out-of-state equals in-state. Official cost page (loc.edu/admissions/financial-aid-2/cost/, 'Tuition Update Fall 2026') publishes tuition per-credit at $472/credit and no flat annual figure. Full-time (12 credits/semester x 2 = 24 credits/yr) x $472 = $11,328 annual tuition. Excludes housing ($1,800/sem) and meals ($1,320/sem). Per-credit fees ($125 activity, $200 health) not added due to unstated frequency.
